summary: Palo Alto, California, finance and economics background, strong interest in web 2.0 companies and technology startups, advocates for meritocracy and high IQ as determinants of success, critical of wealth inequality and government intervention, supports gig economy and entrepreneurship, skeptical of traditional education, identifies as a rationalist, engages in discussions about automation and job displacement, expresses concern over societal trends and economic policies, follows and analyzes stock market trends, particularly in tech, expresses views on the importance of cognitive ability in economic outcomes, has a critical view of mainstream media and sensationalism, likely to participate in online communities focused on economics and technology.
